en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black and white winter photograph of a city square or park with historic stone and brick buildings in the background, ornate rooftops, and a fountain in the center. There is heavy snow on the ground, and a few people can be seen walking on the path. The text in the bottom corner reads 'Sundsvall. Vängåfvan.' The back of the postcard has cursive handwriting, a green Swedish stamp (5 öre), and is addressed to Hanna Johanson in Stockholm, Sweden. Postal marks are visible.
